summary: A 120-foot Aermotor fire tower in Lincoln State Park, Spencer County, Indiana, built by CCC crews around 1935 and open to the public as of 2025.

facts.design: 120-foot Aermotor tower built by Civilian Conservation Corps crews

access.note: The NHLR entry says it is open to the public as of 2025.

visit.trail_note: Mark A's undated site notes say it is climbable up into the cab.

events.note: NHLR gives 1935 for CCC construction. Mark A notes a wall photo labelled circa 1937 and a 1936 county map that does not show the tower.
Registered January 2, 2026 as US 1813, IN 12; nominated by Eli Gray.

notes_for_editor: Only two readable sources. The build year is disputed: NHLR says 1935, while Mark A's wall photo note (circa 1937) and the 1936 map point later. A Living New Deal search snippet gives 1934, but that page returned HTTP 403 and is not cited. An AP/Herald-Times search snippet describes the tower reopening after a decades-long closure, but that page returned HTTP 403 and no closure or reopening is cited here, so an editor should check it by hand. The brief's access 'unknown' can be updated to public (NHLR, as of 2025). No staffing history was found in the readable sources.
